key_insights: Backpack slot structure: 8 bytes per slot (4-byte artifact_id + 4-byte data); IDs fit in 1 byte (<256), so on cascade shift only the first byte of each ID changes
Hero army in this save has 5 active slots (slot[0]..slot[4]); slots 5+ appear to be hero name area (overlap with character data)
Doll slot fill triggers NO stat recalc (unlike equip in some other games) — only the doll slot itself and backpack count change
HotA replay log (base64-encoded) at 0x130B07-0x130B8F is updated on every action
Action counter at 0x000003B7 increments by 1 for every user action (army swap + equip = 1 action, not 2)

key_insights: Mage Guild Lv3 cost (5 wood + 5 ore + 1000 gold) verified exactly against player resources
Building bitmask encoding: stores CURRENT level bit only (not all-built-levels). Upgrading Lv2->Lv3 clears bit 1 and sets bit 2 in byte[3]
Mage Guild upgrade triggers spell list rearrangement in town spell pool (spells are re-rolled when guild level changes)
Hero spell book bitmask at 0x140246 has 'cast this turn' flags — bit cleared when spell memorized/cast
Player resources layout: 7 x 4-byte LE ints in order [Wood, Mercury, Ore, Sulfur, Crystal, Gems, Gold] starting at 0x13E3E7
Only 13 byte ranges changed — building a structure is one of the cleanest diffs in the H3 save format
